items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever have the Robichaux band, the Joe Robichaux band? [INTERVIEWEE] Shucks, all the time that said Casper's Hall... Robichaux, yeah. Robichaux, yeah he had some young fellas there...

ctx.x: I never did wonder much, you know. I'd always stay home and like I'm doing now. Never did fall for just to stay out there drinking, you know. Some of them would drink, drink until they fall out, you see. But I never let liquor...
Did you ever have the Robichaux band, the Joe Robichaux band?

Shucks, all the time that said Casper's Hall. Oh yeah, you know that. He played left hand too. Yeah. As bad he could play too up there. Left hand. Straight break on that violin, shucks. That didn't stop it. Robichaux, yeah. Robichaux, yeah he had some young fellas there, some young Robichaux. Yeah, he used to stay down there on Galvest Street. Downtown.
